title: Partner playback request blocked by CORS

partner_report.symptom: Player fails during initialization with browser CORS error
partner_report.expected_behavior: Playback-related request should succeed from partner origin
partner_report.actual_behavior: Browser blocks the request before the player can initialize

console_signals: Access to fetch at 'https://video.example.com/api/playback' from origin 'https://partner.example.com' has been blocked by CORS policy
Response to preflight request doesn't pass access control check
likely_root_cause: Required CORS headers are missing or invalid for the requesting partner origin and method
repro_steps: Inspect preflight and follow-up request behavior in the network panel
Verify missing or invalid CORS headers in the response
recommended_partner_actions: Confirm preflight handling for the expected methods and headers
Check whether credentials/methods/headers align with browser request behavior
Retry with a minimal reproduction page to isolate embed-specific behavior
